goal: Prevent silent payment shared secret corruption caused by unintended inputs being counted as eligible
Ensure only valid P2WPKH and nested P2SH-P2WPKH inputs contribute public keys during payment derivation
reviewability: Code is ready for review with no blockers identified
agreement: Early support with no open objections

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it fixes a cryptographic correctness bug in silent payment input key aggregation
Ineligible P2SH inputs or malformed witness stacks could otherwise corrupt derived shared secrets
Divergent shared secrets between sender and receiver could make silent payments undetectable
